skill_name: Describe the economic condition of China after the 2008 global banking crisis.
workflow: The 2008 global banking crisis had a significant impact on the Chinese economy. In the immediate aftermath of the crisis, China saw a sharp decline in exports, capital flight, and a decrease in consumer confidence. These factors, combined with a decrease in household savings, put pressure on the Chinese government to respond.
